hypothesis.statement: All four probes varied `mt`'s STATEMENTS; its DECLARATION was never moved, and declaration order is the one lever class the decl-order law says reaches home assignment. Definition sites at HEAD, from `fnasm game/enemy/critter CritterGolemAI 0x100:0x130 --diff`: OURS defines the constant twice, `@0x108 li r0,-1` (consumed by the three stores at +0x114, +0x120 and +0x128) and `@0x124 li r29,-1` (the value that survives `@0x12c bl CritterGetDoAction`); the TARGET defines it once, `@0x108 li r29,-1`, and consumes that same register at +0x114, +0x120 and +0x124. `s32 mt;` currently sits sixth in CritterGolemAI's declaration list, behind four pointer locals and `Critter *child`; the untried lever is to move it to the head of the list so the constant is given a callee-saved home before the block's address arithmetic is scheduled.
